components.note: 土 (earth) — marks soil, ground and earthen things, as in 地 ground, 城 city wall, 坏 broken; a wall was packed earth.
啬 (sè) is only a loose sound hint for qiáng.
衤 (clothing) — marks cloth and garments, as in 衬, 衫, 补; 初 pairs it with 刀 knife: cutting cloth was the first step in making clothes, hence 'beginning'.
刀 (knife) — the cutting tool, as in 分 divide, 切 cut.
心 (heart) — marks feelings, as in 想, 思, 爱; 慰 is to soothe the heart.
尉 (wèi) gives the sound exactly: 慰 wèi.
刂 (knife) — marks cutting and dividing, as in 别, 刻, 划; 列 is to split into rows, hence a line or list.
歹 (bone, death) — marks death and decay, as in 死, 残; 列 liè itself also sounds out 烈 liè and 裂 liè.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — the body-part radical, as in 脸 face, 腿 leg, 脑 brain; 肌 is muscle.
几 (jī) gives the sound exactly: 肌 jī, also in 机 jī and 饥 jī.
肉 — a picture of a slab of meat with its grain lines; as a left-hand radical it shrinks to ⺼ in 脸, 腿, 肌.
雨 (rain) — marks weather, as in 雷 thunder, 雪 snow, 雾 fog; 震 is a quake, as when thunder shakes the ground.
辰 (chén) hints at the sound: 震 zhèn is close to 振 zhèn, which shares it.
女 (woman) — marks women, as in 妈, 姐, 好; its link to 娱 (enjoyment) is historical, so lean on the sound part.
吴 (wú) hints at the sound: 娱 yú is close to 误 wù and 虞 yú.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 推, 按; 抗 is to resist or hold off.
亢 (kàng) gives the sound exactly: 抗 kàng, also in 炕 kàng.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 推, 拿; 掩 is to cover with the hand.
奄 (yǎn) gives the sound: 掩 yǎn, close to 淹 yān and 腌 yān.
典 — a book 冊 set on a stand 丌, a revered text; hence canon, classic, as in 经典 classic and 字典 dictionary.
书 (simplified 書) — the old form shows a brush 聿 writing; to write, then what is written: book, letter.
刂 (knife) — marks cutting and punishing, as in 别, 刻, 划; 刑 is a punishment.
开 (a worn-down 幵) gives the sound exactly: 刑 xíng, also in 形 xíng and 型 xíng.
止 (foot) — two footprints, one above the other, make a step; the same 止 is in 走 walk and 跑 run.
亨 (hēng) — mainly seen in names like 亨利; as a part it sounds out 哼 hēng and 烹 pēng.
艹 (plants) — marks grasses and plants, as in 花 flower, 草 grass, 茶 tea; 苹 is the apple (苹果).
平 (píng) gives the sound exactly: 苹 píng, also in 评 píng.
南 (nán) — south; as a part it sounds out 楠 nán and 喃 nán.
氵 (water) — marks water and washing, as in 洗 wash, 游 swim, 洗澡; 浴 is a bath.
谷 (yù/gǔ) gives the sound: 浴 yù, also in 欲 yù and 裕 yù.
亻 (person) — marks people, as in 你, 他, 们; 伊 is a literary she/he and a name syllable.
尹 (yǐn) is only a loose sound hint for yī.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 推, 拿; 拉 is to pull.
立 (lì) hints at the sound: 拉 lā is close, as in 垃 lā.
阝 (hill, from 阜) on the left — marks slopes and barriers, as in 院, 陆, 附, 阶; 障 is a barrier.
章 (zhāng) hints at the sound: 障 zhàng is close, as in 彰 zhāng.
石 (stone) — marks stone and hard things, as in 破 break, 码, 砖 brick; a stone in the road is an obstacle.
攵 (tap, strike) — marks action and effort, as in 数, 教, 放, 改; 敏 is quick and sharp.
每 (měi) hints at the sound: 敏 mǐn is close.
辶 (movement) — marks walking and roads, as in 过, 进, 送; 遵 is to follow a path.
尊 (zūn) gives the sound exactly: 遵 zūn, and also gives the sense of honouring.
宀 (roof) — a house or shelter, as in 家 home, 安 safe, 完; a hand 寸 under a roof means guarding.
寸 (hand, inch) — originally a hand, as in 对, 寻, 封.
纟 (silk thread, from 糸) — marks thread and ties, as in 线, 红, 约; 维 is a rope that holds things together.
隹 (zhuī, short-tailed bird) is only a loose sound clue for wéi, as in 推 tuī and 谁 shéi.
营 (yíng) — camp, to run a business; as a part it sounds out 荧 yíng, 萤 yíng and 莹 yíng.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand; 扫 (simplified 掃) is a hand with a broom 帚, to sweep.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — marks meat and the body, as in 脸, 腿; 腊 is dried or preserved meat.
昔 (xī) is a loose hint for là; 借 jiè and 错 cuò share it.
艹 (plants) — marks grasses and flowers, as in 草, 茶, 菜; 花 is a flower.
化 (huà) hints at the sound: 花 huā is close, and 化 also gives 华 huá and 货 huò.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talk and agreements, as in 说, 请, 计; 订 is to book or settle by word.
丁 (dīng) hints at the sound: 订 dìng is close, as in 钉 dīng and 顶 dǐng.
心 (heart) — marks feelings, as in 想, 怕, 思; 忌 is a feeling of jealousy or dread.
己 (jǐ) hints at the sound: 忌 jì is close, as in 记 jì and 纪 jì.
亻 (person) — marks people and states, as in 你, 休 rest; 倦 is a tired person.
卷 (juǎn) hints at the sound: 倦 juàn is close, as in 圈 juàn.
冫 (ice, two drops) — marks cold and freezing, as in 冷 cold, 冻 freeze, 凉 cool; 冰 is 冫 plus 水 water: frozen water.
买 (mǎi, buy) — its sound is almost the same as 卖 mài, and the meaning is the opposite: buy and sell.
钅 (metal, from 金) — marks metals, as in 铁 iron, 钱 money, 银 silver; 钢 is steel.
冈 (gāng) gives the sound exactly: 钢 gāng, also in 刚 gāng and 纲 gāng.
珏 (two jades) — here the two 王 shapes suggest strings stretched over a body; 琴 is a string instrument.
今 (jīn) is only a loose sound hint for qín.
阝 (town, from 邑) on the right — marks places and towns, as in 都 capital, 邮 post, 邻 neighbour.
良 (liáng) hints at the sound: 郎 láng is close, as in 狼 láng, 廊 láng and 朗 lǎng.
亻 (person) — marks people, as in 你, 他, 做; 仇 is an enemy, a person you hate.
九 (jiǔ) is only a loose sound hint for chóu.
⺮ (bamboo) — marks bamboo and things woven or made from it, as in 笔 pen, 筷 chopsticks, 箱 box; 篮 is a woven basket.
监 (jiān) is a loose hint for lán; 蓝 lán shares it.
癶 (two feet) — two feet stepping upward: 登 is to climb or board, as in 登山 mountain-climbing.
豆 (dòu) is only a loose sound hint; 登 dēng also sounds out 灯 dēng and 凳 dèng.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talk and questions, as in 说, 请, 问; 诊 is a doctor questioning and examining.
㐱 (zhěn) gives the sound exactly: 诊 zhěn, also in 疹 zhěn.
木 (wood) — marks trees and timber, as in 树, 桥, 板; 材 is timber, then material.
才 (cái) gives the sound exactly: 材 cái, also in 财 cái.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拿, 提; 揭 is to lift off a cover.
曷 (hé) is a loose hint for jiē; 喝 hē and 渴 kě share it.
日 (sun) — marks light and time, as in 明, 晴, 早; 晓 is dawn, when the sun comes up, and so to know.
尧 (yáo) is a loose hint for xiǎo; 烧 shāo and 浇 jiāo share it.
日 (sun) — dusk, when the sun sinks low, as in 暗 dark, 晚 evening; 昏 also means faint.
氏 here stands in for an older 氐 (low); 昏 hūn sounds out 婚 hūn.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talk, as in 说, 语, 讲; 讽 is mocking talk.
风 (fēng) hints at the sound: 讽 fěng is close, as in 枫 fēng.
冫 (ice, two drops) — marks ice and cold, as in 冰, 冷, 冻; 凌 means ice, as in 冰凌, and being bitingly cold.
夌 (líng) gives the sound: 凌 líng, also in 陵 líng and 菱 líng.
